candidateOccurrences.sourceText: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon, and reached to Zebulun, and to the valley of Iphtah El northward to Beth Emek and Neiel. It went out to Cabul on the left hand,
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Allammelech, Amad, Mishal. It reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: and Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, even to great Sidon.
